paper_title: One-Step Blade-Coated Highly Efficient Nonfullerene Organic Solar Cells with a Self-Assembled Interfacial Layer Enabled by Solvent Vapor Annealing
source_file: /home/wzfeng/MySearch/PhotoRag/MD/Solar RRL - 2019 - Lin - One‐Step Blade‐Coated Highly Efficient Nonfullerene Organic Solar Cells with a Self‐Assembled/auto/Solar RRL - 2019 - Lin - One‐Step Blade‐Coated Highly Efficient Nonfullerene Organic Solar Cells with a Self‐Assembled.md

knowledge_points.content: One-step doctor-blade printed organic solar cells using PBDB-T:IT-M and a self-assembled PFN interfacial layer achieve a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 11.14% after solvent vapor annealing.
knowledge_points.evidence: Remarkably, the spontaneous formation of a fine, self-organized IL between the bulk heterojunction (BHJ) layer and the indium tin oxide (ITO) electrode facilitated by SVA yields solar cells with a significantly higher PCE (11.14%) than in control devices (8.05%) without SVA

knowledge_points.content: The optimal solvent vapor annealing (SVA) condition for the PFN:PBDB-T:IT-M system involves exposure to chlorobenzene (CB) vapor at a substrate temperature of 70 °C for 30 minutes.
knowledge_points.evidence: After the mixtures of PFN:BHJ films are blade-coated (Figure 1c), the samples are directly placed into a Petri dish filled with chlorobenzene (CB) solution on a hot plate maintained at 70 °C... The optimum SVA duration is found to be 30 min for this particular system.

knowledge_points.content: Vertical phase separation in PFN:BHJ blends is driven by surface energy differences, where PFN (48.2 mN m⁻¹) migrates toward the high-energy ITO electrode (51.1 mN m⁻¹), while the BHJ components (22 mN m⁻¹) remain at the top surface.
knowledge_points.evidence: the surface energy of PFN layer (48.2 mN m−1) is much higher than that of the donor-acceptor BHJ film (22 mN m−1) and close to that of ITO (51.1 mN m−1). Due to high surface energies of both ITO and PFN layers, the PFN molecules in PFN:BHJ film are expected to migrate toward the surface of the ITO electrode

knowledge_points.content: X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) of the S 2p signal is used to confirm the completeness of vertical phase separation; the absence or suppression of sulfur at the bottom interface indicates the presence of a pure PFN layer.
knowledge_points.evidence: Because PFN does not contain any sulfur, any measured S 2p signal can safely be attributed to the presence of the PBDB-T and/or IT-M molecules on that particular interface... The analysis of the top interface (Figure 3e), on the other hand, yields a strong S 2p signal for all blend layers, indicating that PFN migrates to the bottom interface

knowledge_points.content: One-step printing with SVA produces a smoother interfacial layer (RMS roughness of 1.83 nm) compared to two-step sequential doctor-blade printing (RMS roughness of 2.07 nm).
knowledge_points.evidence: the RMS of the surface roughness which for type-I reduces rapidly from 5.24 to 1.83 nm upon SVA treatment. Surprisingly, the latter RMS value is even lower than that of type-II film (2.07 nm).

knowledge_points.content: Grazing incidence wide angle X-ray scattering (GIWAXS) analysis shows that SVA treatment increases the crystallinity of the IT-M acceptor, evidenced by increased signal intensity in both lamellar and π-stacking diffractions.
knowledge_points.evidence: Following the SVA treatment, the signal intensity increases significantly for both lamellar and π stacking diffraction of the IT-M component within the type-I layers, suggesting an increase of the acceptor crystallinity

knowledge_points.content: Solvent vapor annealing improves the open-circuit voltage (Voc) by increasing the charge-transfer state energy (Ect) and reducing the reorganization energy (λ) to 0.20 eV.
knowledge_points.evidence: the λ value of 0.20 eV is obtained from the fitting in Figure S11... which is lower than 0.23 eV for type-II device and 0.28 eV for type-I cells without SVA... conformal and uniform nature of the self-forming PFN interface layer in type-I device following SVA treatment is responsible for the increased ECT and VOC.

knowledge_points.content: The empirical relationship between open-circuit voltage and charge-transfer state energy in these devices follows the equation Voc = Ect/q - 0.6.
knowledge_points.evidence: the ECT and VOC are in good agreement with the empirical relation of VOC = ECT/q − 0.6

knowledge_points.content: The active layer blend consists of the donor polymer PBDB-T and the nonfullerene small molecule acceptor IT-M, with PFN added as a 4 wt% dopant for the self-assembled interfacial layer.
knowledge_points.evidence: composed of the poly[(2,6-(4,8- bis(5-(2-ethylhexyl)thiophen-2-yl)benzo[1,2-b:4,5-b'ldithiophene)- co-(1,3-di(5-thiophene-2-yl)-5,7-bis(2-ethylhexyl)-benzo 1,2·c:4,5·c'] dithiophene-4,8-dione)] (PBDB-T) as the donor and IT-M as the acceptor... about 4 wt% of PFN from CB:DIO solution was doped into the PBDB-T:IT-M active solution.

knowledge_points.content: Increasing the substrate temperature during the one-step doctor-blade printing process above 40 °C without SVA leads to a decrease in PCE due to rapid drying, which inhibits the formation of a continuous PFN interlayer.
knowledge_points.evidence: the PCE for cells processed at > 40 °C decreases with an increasing substrate temperature, an effect ascribed to fast drying of the bilayer that forbids the formation of a continuous and uniform PFN interlayer.
